caption:
A lead calls your office, texts your cell, and emails the front desk.

14 days full access. No card. Cancel anytime.

Refer another business. You both get a free month when they subscribe.

rationale: Reels still win reach for cold-audience offer content, and this fills Platform/Trial with an unclaimed pain (scattered, unthreaded conversations across channels) using the verified unified-inbox feature, distinct from every prior tool-sprawl, onboarding, referral, missed-call, revenue-attribution, and win-back angle already shipped.
